$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — LLM commander (L-1 CE-4676, L-2 CE-4679 ⑤; docs/designs/llm-commander/DESIGN_LLM_Commander.md §1, §11): the Platoon's brain is a seat with the SCRIPTED mind; Alpha Squad and Bravo Squad fight with the game AI; Red's Defenders hold the sheds. L-2 ⑤ gives the commander a fight: Blue starts behind the L-Block (out of Red's sight), the objective and the support position are behind the Low Wall, and six 1.5 m walls stagger the lane to the house. Measured 2026-11-22: contact from 76 s to past 420 s (Alpha Set behind cover, Red worn from 5 to 2). ⚠ NOT EXPRESSED: L-1's check ④ 'the fight ends — Red is beaten OR the platoon breaks contact — before the time limit' needs the 'any' combinator (DESIGN_Scenario_Regression §9, approved R-4077, not built); the L-1 row that encoded only the break-contact branch pinned the measured outcome this fight was made to remove, and is withdrawn (DECISIONS_Backend CE-4679 #8). FEATURE scenario (no golden until two fresh runs agree, §5). The 'report' cue reads the brain node's report log (editor tier).

expect.name: both squads are sent to the objective at the start
a squad attacks within 1 s of the first SPOT into the platoon
the platoon's own play never runs (no PlatoonHold, no ReactToFireFromBuilding)
Alpha Squad reports to the platoon
Bravo Squad reports to the platoon
the squads are in contact for at least 60 s (Red still fires 60 s after its first shot, and Blue answers)
Blue fires back after the first minute of the fight
